notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارٌ اَلسَّابَاطِيُّ» names the asker; the Imam who answers is not named in this text, so no route is written (rule 5)
«وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارٌ اَلسَّابَاطِيُّ» names the asker; the Imam who answers is not named in this text, so no route is written (rule 5)
Opens «وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارٌ» (Ammar asked him): the asker is not a link (rule 5) and the answering Imam is only the pronoun «سأله», never named in this text, so no route can be written from it
